_doc: Wiring contracts for regenerative-nexus-guard.mjs. Declares, per artifact domain, what 'wired' MEANS (required edges), what is safe to auto-scaffold, what is owner-gated, and explicit exemptions (intentional standalone / library / demo / fixture / retired). Edit this file — NOT the detector — to suppress a false positive, and always with a reason + owner + reviewBy. An exemption with no reason is itself a finding.

module.note: import-graph reachability (deterministic, source-derived). GitNexus call-graph is the phase-2 structural upgrade.

export.note: textual zero-reference scan (LOW confidence). GitNexus in-degree is the phase-2 structural upgrade. Never delete on this signal alone.

filenameExemptions._doc: Regex (tested against the repo-relative path) → reason. These are CLASSES of intentional non-wiring (CLI harnesses, demos, fixtures, test workers) that would otherwise look unwired. Narrow on purpose.

rules.reason: spawned test worker — entered as a child process, not imported
trace post-processor — CLI-run over the trace file

pathExemptions._doc: Exact repo-relative path → {reason, owner, reviewBy, classes}. For specific intentional standalones / public APIs / parked research. classes:'*' exempts all.

rules.reason: scratch proof-data extractor for the transfer-distance proof (regen helper, not a registered math method) — see transfer-distance.proof.mjs
docs/archive consistency test — covers a markdown corpus, not an .mjs module
library-helper — required by _SYSTEM/Scripts/pulse-orchestrator.mjs (appendFinding/withLock/findingsByTurn); not a settings-registered hook (verified by Codex lane F, call sites)
spawned worker — forked detached by .claude/hooks/scout-orchestrator.js (SCOUT_RUNNER, expects argv not stdin); not a settings hook (verified by Codex lane F)
